title: Generative AI Lifecycle Slides
description: This article and slide show how GenAI life cycle is more complex than traditional AI cycle. Learn the additional factors involved in GenAI lifecycle. Prompt design, handling foundation model, fine tuning of model, evaluation of fine tuning, guard rails of generative ai are additional factors that should be considered for building generative AI in enterprises.
